title: 7.11 Outdoors
unit_title: Unit 7: My Body, My Day and My Free Time
unit_outcome: Name the body and clothes, say how you feel and what the weather is like, talk about free time, make plans with friends and ask someone to repeat.
goal: Name things outdoors: Das ist ein Fluss. Der Himmel ist blau.
grammar_function: Das ist ein/eine/das + thing. Subject + ist + color.
